protocol.scope: Retrospective grouped CV; all locations previously exposed in this project. Not a fresh blind benchmark.
protocol.checkpoint_policy: Same best.pt validation AP50:95 policy; test all checkpoints only after all ten training runs finish.
protocol.primary_metric: Equal-weight mean of the five outer-location BEV AP50 values; report all locations separately.
protocol.secondary_metric: Pooled out-of-fold BEV AP50/AP50:95, combining native TP/confidence/target statistics. All 400 real frames scored once per training source.
